name: Hahnenkamm Sunrise Brunch
beschreibung: The legendary Hahnenkamm brunch on the Sonnberg is a gourmet highlight. Guests enjoy breathtaking views of the Kitzbüheler Alpen alongside a lavish brunch buffet with regional and international specialties. Featuring live cooking stations and open seating.
kurzbeschreibung: Exclusive brunch on the Hahnenkamm with panoramic mountain views and culinary delicacies.
